items.description: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
items.rationale: Lightning-induced overvoltage is covered under 2.3.3, but the replacement value is capped at the EUR 5,000 appliance aggregate sub-limit (6.2.4, 7.1.1). The notification states nothing was surge-protected, so the payable amount is halved: 0.5 x 5,000 = about 2,500; a deductible or a lower actual price could reduce this further.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out (3 pcs)
items.rationale: Diagnosis, the wiring safety check and the report are not repair costs, and diagnostics are the contractor's own business outlay (7.1.8(e)). Under 7.1.10 the bundled line is assessed by its predominant non-repair purpose, so it is likely excluded. At most one call-out per invoice could be allowed under 7.1.8(d).
